description: Adjusted year-end physical closing inventory stock-in-trade valued at cost ₹2,80,000 into Trading Account
narration: Being physical closing stock at cost recorded as current asset and credited to Trading Account
explanation: Closing Inventory Adjustment: Debit Closing Stock Asset A/c Dr ₹2,80,000, Credit Trading Account Cr ₹2,80,000.

description: Transferred opening inventory stock balance ₹2,20,000 to Trading Account at financial year end
narration: Being opening stock balance transferred to Trading Account to close account
explanation: Transfer Entry: Debit Trading A/c Dr ₹2,20,000, Credit Opening Stock A/c Cr ₹2,20,000.

description: Transferred net purchases (₹6,50,000) and direct carriage inward expenses (₹25,000) to Trading Account
narration: Being net purchases and direct carriage expenses transferred to Trading Account
explanation: Closing Direct Expenses: Debit Trading A/c Dr ₹6,75,000, Credit Purchases A/c ₹6,50,000, Credit Carriage Inward A/c ₹25,000.

description: Transferred net sales revenue (₹9,80,000) to Trading Account at financial year end
narration: Being net sales revenue transferred to Trading Account
explanation: Closing Revenue Entry: Debit Sales A/c Dr ₹9,80,000, Credit Trading A/c Cr ₹9,80,000.

description: Transferred year-end Gross Profit ₹3,65,000 from Trading Account to Profit & Loss Account
narration: Being Gross Profit transferred from Trading Account to Profit & Loss Account
explanation: Gross Profit Transfer: Debit Trading A/c Dr ₹3,65,000, Credit Profit & Loss A/c Cr ₹3,65,000.

description: Transferred total indirect operating expenses (Rent ₹1.8L, Salaries ₹2.1L, Electricity ₹35k, Depreciation ₹1.67L = ₹5,92,000) to Profit & Loss Account
narration: Being all indirect operating expense nominal accounts closed to Profit & Loss Account
explanation: Closing Indirect Expenses: Debit Profit & Loss A/c Dr ₹5,92,000, crediting individual expense nominal accounts.

description: Transferred total indirect revenue incomes (Commission ₹24k, Interest ₹18k, Discount Received ₹8k = ₹50,000) to Profit & Loss Account
narration: Being all indirect revenue income nominal accounts closed to Profit & Loss Account
explanation: Closing Indirect Revenue: Debits individual income accounts (Total Dr ₹50,000) and credits Profit & Loss A/c Cr ₹50,000.

description: Transferred audited Net Profit ₹1,80,000 from Profit & Loss Account to Proprietor Capital Account
narration: Being audited Net Profit transferred to Proprietor Capital Account to increase equity
explanation: Net Profit Transfer: Debit Profit & Loss A/c Dr ₹1,80,000, Credit Proprietor Capital A/c Cr ₹1,80,000.

description: Created year-end Provision for Income Tax Liability ₹45,000 on net profit
narration: Being year-end provision for income tax created on net profit
explanation: Income Tax Provision: Debit Income Tax Expense A/c ₹45,000, Credit Provision for Income Tax Liability A/c ₹45,000.

description: Transferred total year-end Drawings Account balance ₹55,000 to Proprietor Capital Account to close drawings ledger
narration: Being total Drawings account balance transferred to Capital Account to close ledger
explanation: Closing Drawings Ledger: Debit Proprietor Capital A/c Dr ₹55,000 (reducing equity), Credit Drawings A/c Cr ₹55,000.
